currentTitle: 截图里的字，怎么变糊了？
Why Did the Text Go Blurry?
currentParagraphs: 同一张文字截图，以较低画质保存为 JPEG 后，字的边缘变得模糊了。
Save a text screenshot as a low-quality JPEG, and the edges of the letters can turn blurry.
照片有时适合用有损压缩来减小文件。文字截图和图表要保留清晰的线条，可以优先考虑无损保存。
Lossy compression can work well for photos. For text and diagrams, lossless formats help preserve sharp lines.
earlierParagraphs: 有损压缩会舍弃部分图像信息来缩小文件。丢掉的细节，无法从压缩后的文件中完整还原。
Lossy compression makes files smaller by discarding some image information. The discarded detail cannot be fully recovered from the compressed file.
无损压缩改变数据的记录方式，不丢弃原有信息。还原后的图像与压缩前一致。
Lossless compression changes how data is stored without discarding information. The original image can be reconstructed exactly.

noteTitle: 文字截图，优先保留细节
note: 低画质 JPEG 的有损压缩会丢掉部分细节，可能让字边变糊。文字截图和图表可以优先考虑无损保存。
Low-quality JPEG compression discards detail and can blur text edges. Consider lossless formats for screenshots and diagrams.

q: 低画质 JPEG 为什么可能让字边变糊？
Why can a low-quality JPEG blur text edges?
a: 有损压缩丢掉了部分图像细节，文字边缘也可能受到影响。
Lossy compression discards image detail, which can affect the edges of letters.

q: 有损压缩和无损压缩，最主要的区别是什么？
What is the main difference between lossy and lossless compression?
a: 有损压缩会丢弃信息；无损压缩可以完整还原压缩前的数据。
Lossy compression discards information; lossless compression can reconstruct the original data exactly.
